audience: B2B sales, marketing, recruiting and business development teams with a NeverBounce account

useCases.title: Check remaining verification credits
useCases.text: Read your credit balance and the number of jobs in each processing state.

useCases.title: Review a bulk verification job
useCases.text: List jobs, inspect a selected job and page through its verification results.

useCases.title: Prepare a business contact list
useCases.text: Create a bulk job from the addresses you provide without starting paid verification. Start it separately with a maximum credit allowance.

useCases.title: Verify a newly entered business email
useCases.text: Check one address at its point of entry. Each check spends vendor credits; existing lists should use bulk jobs.
